name: Aquaculture Fish and Old Rods
description: What stays from Aquaculture, and what old rods still do.

pages.title: Aquaculture Fish and Old Rods
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Aquaculture's **fish** bite on any rod, each in its own biome.
- Its **rods, hooks, lines, bobbers and Tackle Box** can't be crafted.
- Rods you **already own** still work, the classic way.
- Fillet knives, Worm Farm, Neptunium and its food all stay.

Aquaculture's fishing gear is retired: one tackle system, not two. Retired items are hidden from JEI. Copies you own stay in your inventory and keep working.\
\
Aquaculture's worms and leeches are bait on every rod here.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Where Aquaculture fish bite:**

- **Jungle rivers:** arapaima, piranha, tambaqui, Arrau turtle.
- **Hot rivers** (desert, badlands, savanna): bayad, boulti, capitaine, synodontis.
- **Swamps:** perch, box turtle.
- **Rivers:** gar, minnow, pink salmon.

- **Fresh water**, by season and temperature: bluegill, smallmouth bass, rainbow and brown trout, muskellunge, carp; catfish at night.
- **Ocean and beach:** Atlantic cod, halibut and herring, blackfish, Pacific halibut, pollock, red grouper, tuna, jellyfish.
- **Mushroom fields:** red and brown shrooma.
- **Twilight Forest:** starshell turtle.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Arapaima, bluegill, carp, catfish, rainbow trout, smallmouth bass and tuna are Aquaculture's fish, and mackerel, coelacanth, anglerfish and mahi-mahi Hybrid Aquatic's: one item each, so the journal lists each once and recipes take one item. Their weights match the catch.

pages.title: Old Rods
pages.text:
An Aquaculture rod you already have fishes Aquaculture's way: cast, wait for the splash, reel in. No fight, no drag; catches come from Aquaculture's tables.\
\
Its hook, line, bobber and bait go in through the rod's menu or an old Tackle Box, and fit no other rod.

**Hybrid Aquatic hooks** held in the **off hand** while you cast work with old Aquaculture rods. On every other rod they go in the hook slot: [#](2E5AAC)[Reels, Lines and Hooks](entry://fishing/tackle)[#]().

pages.title: Fillet Knife
pages.text: Iron, Gold, Diamond and Neptunium Fillet Knives still craft. Craft one with a fish for Raw Fillets by its weight; a Farmer's Delight knife on the cutting board, or the Cleaning Table, works too.

Neptunium still comes from [#](2E5AAC)[Neptune's Bounty](entry://fishing/crates)[#](), reeled in on any rod in open water. The Neptunium rod is out of that loot.\
\
Create **Integrated Farming**'s [#](2E5AAC)[Fishing Nets](entry://food/integrated_farming)[#]() are not rods. They fish on moving contraptions.
